display_name: LoRa W24 原生带外 IQ 条件恢复（Full）
description: Matched scratch aperture versus native high-pass sample statistics. Additional received native IQ could improve data-dependent noise inference without changing W24 preprocessing.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 goal, lawful source U_s same-waveform paired IQ, frozen W24 only after added source coefficients freeze, Full route.

code.environment: Archived N607 CVS-RFFI with exact registered W24 release

data.representation: Native 8192 complex samples; class scores use W24 8×2×432.
data.contract_ref: Pinned LoRa full packet native IQ contract
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 300 unique opaque source V packet IDs as frozen outer-objective source run
data.validation_ref: Native source split 392005. Disjoint 16000 U_s fit pool and 160 waveform holdout. Same physical Full 300-source panel and exact archived direct parity.
data.leo_config_ref: Full native practical and clean. Prediction uses generated receive IQ.

permissions.claim_scope: Source calibration and source screen. No F/TX/V/target access at fit or freeze. DURA and W24 checkpoints read only for their allowed roles.

checkpoint.initialization: Two matched randomly initialized all-packet 405991-parameter reconstructors. Frozen prior used only for waveform-independent historical comparison.

sources.role: Frozen source predictions used as a matched comparison after both scratch candidates freeze
Pinned analytic aperture, tracking and generic waveform generator code only, no learned checkpoint

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source frozen checkpoint binding and actual paired blind decisions must match the immutable prior source run.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No historical restoration weight used in fit, freeze or candidate predictions. Historical outer predictions appended by unchanged physical order for post-freeze paired scoring only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze both at step 12000. Native half must beat frozen parent by at least 18 six and 10 low, clean at least direct, and beat the aperture half on both practical metrics.

execution.gpu_policy: One N607 GPU, 3 then 6,0, >=12 GiB free and existing process cap. 8 CPU workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on illegal inputs, unsuccessful genuine source-only smoke, nonfinite fit/holdout, source row or control mismatch, incomplete prediction, or independent scoring failure.

rows.method: Original W24 aperture residual versus native 1 MHz high-pass local complex mean and log power, matching dimension and network. Fixed half/full center edits and preserved edges.
rows.seed_notes: No training/model seed or support. The 300 source V panel and waveform namespace are reused. Evaluation seed identifies W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: 12000 updates per arm, same batch 8 and IQ, AdamW cosine .0006 to .00008, fixed 2000/6000/12000 source waveform evaluations. Full source seven views after final freeze.

notes: Both scratch 405991-parameter arms have equal initialization, labels excluded, same optimizer, source pair draws and weights.
Candidate 33-tap Hamming high pass at 0.384 of raw Nyquist. Four nearby native residual samples and fixed local RMS serve as extra observed fields.
Control computes corresponding three fields using its received W24-width tracked center. Both render measured native guard unchanged and use frozen W24 only after source freeze.
Full-only source screen. Exact W24 direct-control parity, fixed historical outer decisions and independent source truth-last.
One independent P0/P1 review and finite gradients, filter response, shape and source smoke tests.
